messages.content:
You are an expert antenna engineer and HFSS scripting assistant.
Your goal is to design an antenna in Ansys HFSS that satisfies the following requirements:

设计一个中心频率 2.45 GHz 的微带贴片天线，S11 < -10 dB，-10 dB 带宽 > 100 MHz，峰值增益 > 3 dBi。

You can interact with HFSS through the provided tools. At each step, decide which tool(s) to call.
After each tool call, you will receive the result/observation from HFSS.
Design iteratively: adjust geometry/material/variables, solve, read results, and refine.
When you are satisfied with the design, call `finalize_design` with a short summary and the final metrics.

Environment (read carefully — most mistakes happen here):
- `update_geometry` executes a Python snippet via PyAEDT. A variable `hfss` is in scope:
  an `ansys.aedt.core.Hfss` object already connected to your project.
  Use the PyAEDT API, e.g.:
    hfss.modeler.create_box(origin=["-W/2", "-L/2", "0mm"], sizes=["W", "L", "1.6mm"], name="Substrate", material="FR4_epoxy")
    hfss.create_setup("Setup1")
  Do NOT use the AEDT record-script style (oEditor.CreateRectangle / oDesign...) — it will fail.
- Fixed naming convention (do not invent other names):
  solution setup: "Setup1"; frequency sweep: "Sweep1"; wave port: "Port1".
  When reading results use solution name "Setup1 : Sweep1" and expression dB(S(1,1)).
- To read gain / radiation efficiency, call `get_result` with a report name mentioning
  gain or efficiency (e.g. "Gain Plot"); the result returns peak_gain_dbi and
  radiation_efficiency_percent.
- `solve` calls are budget-limited. Every tool result reports `remaining_solve_calls`;
  plan your iterations so you stay within budget.
- Call `export_design` to save the project before `finalize_design`.

Rules:
1. Always use SI units or specify units explicitly (e.g. "28.5mm", "2.45GHz").
2. Keep changes minimal and explain why you make each change.
3. If a simulation or script fails, read the error message in the tool result and fix the issue.
4. Do not invent values that you can read from HFSS; prefer using `get_result`.
5. After finalize_design, no more tool calls are allowed.

Please design an antenna satisfying these requirements:
设计一个中心频率 2.45 GHz 的微带贴片天线，S11 < -10 dB，-10 dB 带宽 > 100 MHz，峰值增益 > 3 dBi。

Start by creating geometry/variables. Report back each step using tools.
我将先建立一个低损耗、较厚基板的 2.45 GHz 嵌入式馈电微带贴片模型。选择 Rogers 5880（εr≈2.2，厚度 3.175 mm）是为了比普通 1.6 mm FR4 获得更宽的阻抗带宽和更高增益。几何先按传输线贴片公式估算：贴片约 40 mm × 39 mm，有限地板约 100 mm × 100 mm，之后用仿真调谐贴片长度和馈电嵌入深度。

function.name: update_geometry
function.arguments:
{"script": "import math
from ansys.aedt.core import Hfss

# Clear existing model
try:
    hfss.modeler.delete()
except Exception:
    pass

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Design variables (all with explicit units)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
hfss["f0"] = "2.45GHz"
hfss["sub_L"] = "100mm"
hfss["sub_W"] = "100mm"
hfss["h_sub"] = "3.175mm"
hfss["t_cu"] = "0.035mm"
hfss["patch_L"] = "39.2mm"
hfss["patch_W"] = "40.0mm"
hfss["feed_W"] = "9.6mm"
hfss["inset_D"] = "12.2mm"
hfss["gap"] = "1.0mm"
hfss["air_margin_xy"] = "35mm"
hfss["air_margin_z"] = "45mm"

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Materials
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
try:
    if "Rogers5880_custom" not in hfss.materials.material_keys:
        mat = hfss.materials.add_material("Rogers5880_custom")
        mat.permittivity = 2.2
        mat.dielectric_loss_tangent = 0.0009
except Exception:
    pass

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Geometry: substrate, ground, inset-fed patch + feed line, air box
# Coordinates: patch centered at x=0,y=0. Substrate z=0..h_sub.
# Ground is a copper box below substrate, top metallization is copper box above.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
substrate = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    origin=["-sub_W/2", "-sub_L/2", "0mm"],
    sizes=["sub_W", "sub_L", "h_sub"],
    name="Substrate",
    material="Rogers5880_custom"
)

ground = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    origin=["-sub_W/2", "-sub_L/2", "-t_cu"],
    sizes=["sub_W", "sub_L", "t_cu"],
    name="Ground",
    material="copper"
)

# Top copper pieces for inset-fed patch.
# Upper patch section (beyond inset)
patch_upper = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    origin=["-patch_W/2", "-patch_L/2+inset_D", "h_sub"],
    sizes=["patch_W", "patch_L-inset_D", "t_cu"],
    name="Patch_Upper",
    material="copper"
)
# Left and right lower patch arms that form the inset slot around the feed line
patch_left = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    origin=["-patch_W/2", "-patch_L/2", "h_sub"],
    sizes=["patch_W/2-feed_W/2-gap", "inset_D", "t_cu"],
    name="Patch_LeftInsetArm",
    material="copper"
)
patch_right = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    origin=["feed_W/2+gap", "-patch_L/2", "h_sub"],
    sizes=["patch_W/2-feed_W/2-gap", "inset_D", "t_cu"],
    name="Patch_RightInsetArm",
    material="copper"
)
# 50-ohm microstrip feed line from lower substrate edge into the inset
feed = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    origin=["-feed_W/2", "-sub_L/2", "h_sub"],
    sizes=["feed_W", "sub_L/2-patch_L/2+inset_D", "t_cu"],
    name="FeedLine",
    material="copper"
)

# Unite all top copper into one conductor for clean electrical connectivity
try:
    hfss.modeler.unite(["Patch_Upper", "Patch_LeftInsetArm", "Patch_RightInsetArm", "FeedLine"])
    # Rename united object if needed
    for obj in hfss.modeler.object_names:
        if obj.startswith("Patch_Upper"):
            hfss.modeler[obj].name = "PatchFeed"
            break
except Exception:
    pass

# Lumped/wave-port sheet at feed input: vertical rectangle from ground to signal strip.
# It is named PortSheet; excitation will be named Port1.
try:
    port_sheet = hfss.modeler.create_rectangle(
        orientation="XZ",
        origin=["-feed_W/2", "-sub_L/2", "0mm"],
        sizes=["feed_W", "h_sub+t_cu"],
        name="PortSheet",
        material="vacuum"
    )
except Exception:
    # Fallback using plane enum if string orientation is not accepted
    from ansys.aedt.core.generic.constants import Plane
    port_sheet = hfss.modeler.create_rectangle(
        orientation=Plane.XZ,
        origin=["-feed_W/2", "-sub_L/2", "0mm"],
        sizes=["feed_W", "h_sub+t_cu"],
        name="PortSheet",
        material="vacuum"
    )

# Air region for radiation boundary
try:
    air = hfss.modeler.create_box(
        origin=["-sub_W/2-air_margin_xy", "-sub_L/2-air_margin_xy", "-air_margin_z"],
        sizes=["sub_W+2*air_margin_xy", "sub_L+2*air_margin_xy", "h_sub+t_cu+2*air_margin_z"],
        name="AirBox",
        material="air"
    )
    hfss.assign_radiation_boundary_to_objects("AirBox", boundary_name="Rad1")
except Exception:
    air = None

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Excitation Port1. Try wave-port assignment first; fall back to lumped port
# if the active PyAEDT API/geometry rules reject a wave port on this sheet.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
port_assigned = False
integration_line = [["0mm", "-sub_L/2", "0mm"], ["0mm", "-sub_L/2", "h_sub+t_cu"]]
try:
    hfss.wave_port(
        assignment="PortSheet",
        create_port_sheet=False,
        integration_line=integration_line,
        name="Port1",
        modes=1,
        impedance=50
    )
    port_assigned = True
except Exception as e1:
    try:
        hfss.create_wave_port_from_sheet(
            sheet="PortSheet",
            axisdir=2,
            name="Port1",
            impedance=50
        )
        port_assigned = True
    except Exception as e2:
        try:
            hfss.lumped_port(
                assignment="PortSheet",
                create_port_sheet=False,
                integration_line=integration_line,
                impedance=50,
                name="Port1"
            )
            port_assigned = True
        except Exception as e3:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Could not assign Port1. wave_port error={e1}; create_wave_port_from_sheet error={e2}; lumped_port error={e3}")

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Analysis setup and broadband interpolating/discrete sweep
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
try:
    # Remove existing setup if present
    for s in list(hfss.setups):
        if getattr(s, 'name', '') == "Setup1":
            hfss.delete_setup("Setup1")
except Exception:
    pass

setup = hfss.create_setup("Setup1")
setup.props["Frequency"] = "2.45GHz"
setup.props["MaximumPasses"] = 12
setup.props["MinimumPasses"] = 2
setup.props["MinimumConvergedPasses"] = 2
setup.props["PercentRefinement"] = 30
setup.props["DeltaS"] = 0.02
try:
    setup.update()
except Exception:
    pass

# Create sweep from 2.2 to 2.7 GHz with fine enough resolution to measure >100 MHz bandwidth
try:
    sweep = setup.add_sweep("Sweep1")
    sweep.props["RangeType"] = "LinearStep"
    sweep.props["RangeStart"] = "2.2GHz"
    sweep.props["RangeEnd"] = "2.7GHz"
    sweep.props["RangeStep"] = "5MHz"
    sweep.props["Type"] = "Interpolating"
    sweep.props["SaveFields"] = False
    sweep.props["SaveRadFields"] = False
    sweep.update()
except Exception:
    try:
        hfss.create_linear_count_sweep(
            setup="Setup1",
            units="GHz",
            start_frequency=2.2,
            stop_frequency=2.7,
            num_of_freq_points=101,
            name="Sweep1",
            sweep_type="Interpolating",
            save_fields=False,
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

# Add an infinite sphere for far-field reports/gain extraction
try:
    hfss.insert_infinite_sphere(name="Infinite Sphere1")
except Exception:
    pass

# Save project state
try:
    hfss.save_project()
except Exception:
    pass
"}
